__comment: DelightfulCompat: Oak's Delight defines c:foods/cheese with only oaksdelight:cheese, so recipes that read this tag (e.g. oaksdelight:cheese_toastie) reject Arbitrary Delight's cheese. Merge Arbitrary Delight's cheese items in so any cheese works. required:false keeps it safe when a mod is absent. (shredded_cheese is half a cheese_block, included so it also counts.)
